start: Workout tab, no workout open, two folders, one of them followed

user_sees: Sheet 'Where should the routine go?' listing the folders
Pick 'My routines': the routine editor opens on 'New routine'
must_not: Two new routines from one tap
The routine put in the followed plan without asking

user_sees: The routine card in its folder with 'Start routine'
must_not: The new routine missing until the app restarts

user_sees: The workout screen opens with the routine's exercises
must_not: An open workout replaced without asking (it must offer Resume or discard)

user_sees: An empty workout opens with the exercises of the last empty workout, and 'Start blank' removes them
must_not: The tile shown while a workout is already open

user_sees: The ready programs page opens
must_not: A blank page

user_sees: Sheet 'New folder' with box 'Folder name' and button 'Create folder'
must_not: A folder made with an empty name

user_sees: Sheet 'Rename folder' with the old name and 'Save name'
must_not: The rename sheet opening under the menu and lost

user_sees: The folder moves at once; the followed folder stays first
must_not: The followed folder moved off the top

steps.action: Tap 'Follow this plan' on another folder
user_sees: That folder is followed; Up next comes from it
must_not: Two folders followed at once

start: A folder with three routines, one of them in the followed plan

steps.action: Tap 'More for <routine>', then 'Duplicate routine' on a routine in the followed plan
user_sees: Pop-up 'Copy saved': '"<name> (copy)" is in My routines, so your plan stays as it is.'
must_not: The copy added to the plan's rotation

steps.action: Tap 'Move to folder…' and pick a folder
user_sees: Sheet 'Move to folder' with each folder and 'Your plan' or 'N routines'
The routine shows in the new folder
must_not: The routine in both folders

steps.action: Drag a routine by its handle to a new place
user_sees: The new order shows at once and stays after a restart
must_not: The order jumping back

start: Workout tab; the phone's storage refuses writes for a moment

user_sees: Pop-up 'Could not save the new order' / 'Please try again.' and the list read again
must_not: The new order shown as saved when it was not

steps.action: Tap 'Start routine' on a routine with no exercises (its button says 'Add exercises')
user_sees: The routine editor opens
must_not: An empty workout started

steps.action: Open the tab when the routines cannot be read
user_sees: After three quiet retries, 'Couldn't load your routines' with a retry
must_not: An endless skeleton
'No routines yet' shown when routines exist

start: A followed folder with three routines and saved workouts from them

user_sees: Question 'Stop following '<folder>'?' saying 'Up next then comes from the routine you did last. Following it again starts its weeks from that day.' with 'Stop following'
must_not: Following stopped without the question

user_sees: The folder followed again, its weeks counted from today
must_not: The old week number kept

user_sees: Question 'Delete '<folder>' folder?' saying 'It'll be gone forever. Its 3 routines go too. Your workout history stays. You stop following this plan.'
After 'Delete': folder and routines gone
must_not: Workout history deleted
Deleted without the question

user_sees: Question 'Delete '<name>'?' saying 'The routine and its exercise list go. Your workout history stays.'
must_not: The routine still on the server copy after delete

start: A member signed in to MettleUp, and a gym that sent a plan

user_sees: The share sheet with the routine names and exercises only
must_not: Body weight, workout history or the member's phone number in the share

steps.action: Look at a folder the gym sent
user_sees: A line under the folder name saying it came from the gym
must_not: A gym plan from another gym

user_sees: It is gone from the phone
must_not: It kept in the member's cloud copy
